question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting the released `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or close the linked PR and this issue as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through `skill_workshop`?
rationale: Automation can verify the released helper is affected and the open PR fixes that old surface, but current main removed the helper and current skill-creator guidance points to Skill Workshop, which is a maintainer product-boundary choice.

options.title: Close obsolete helper path
options.body: Close this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92126 together, documenting that current main no longer supports `init_skill.py` and `skill_workshop` is the supported path.

options.title: Refresh and land helper repair
options.body: Sponsor a refreshed PR or backport that intentionally keeps the helper supported, applies the case-insensitive parser behavior, and adds focused tests for the shipped surface.

recommendation.title: Close obsolete helper path
recommendation.body: Close this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92126 together, documenting that current main no longer supports `init_skill.py` and `skill_workshop` is the supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: The original bundled helper history and released parser surface route most directly through steipete’s `skill-creator` commit.
